messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up: our monorepo sample app fails in the local edge dev server when core package is consumed via pnpm workspace symlink. stack traces and sourcemaps point at the consumer dist instead of package source. Repro:

olivia: - pnpm -w install
olivia: - cd packages/core-lib && pnpm build
olivia: - cd ../../apps/sample && pnpm dev:edge

olivia: Runtime error: Error: Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm' (looks like exports resolution picks wrong entry)

mike: Seen this. pnpm symlinks + bundler realpath/code-path can make package.exports choose the consumer path. Edge bundlers that follow realpath may inline sourcemaps pointing at .pnpm store paths or consumer dist.

mike: Check package.json exports in core-lib. If you only expose ESM entrypoints without a require fallback some dev tooling mis-resolves. We usually add both import and require in exports and include "./package.json" mapping.

tara: Also verify sourcemap config in your build. declarationMap or wrong sourceRoot can leak workspace paths. Try emitting sourcesContent in sourcemaps or set sourceRoot to the package root.

ash: Edge runtimes (V8 isolate based) don't use preserveSymlinks and some bundlers compute resolutions differently. Workarounds: import from the compiled dist in dev (file:../packages/core-lib/dist) or build a single bundle for the edge server.

james: Repro on my machine. Switching pnpm to nodeLinker=node-modules (hoisted) made it go away because it avoids symlinks. Not ideal for everyone though. Node 20 is stricter about exports resolution vs node 18, fwiw.

ci-bot: CI failed: apps/sample-edge  startup  Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm' (job #142)

mike: Short-term fixes: 1) ensure dist contains correct sourcemaps with sourcesContent, 2) make sample dev import from dist path, 3) set esbuild plugin absWorkingDir to repo root so paths are stable. Longer-term: change dev server resolver to prefer workspace package root for symlinked packages.

olivia: I'll add a README note recommending consuming built artifacts for edge local dev, document node versions, and file an issue for the dev server plugin to avoid resolving to realpath when package is a workspace symlink. Draft issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/214

ash: If you need a quick patch, add a resolver check in apps/sample/esbuild-plugin.js: if (isWorkspaceSymlink(id)) return path.join(workspaceRoot, packageDir, 'dist/esm/index.js') — ugly but practical until upstream is fixed.

olivia: Thanks all, will push README + issue and include CI log snippet. :sparkles:
